description: Estimate your one-rep max from any lift with the Epley and Brzycki formulas, plus a full percentage table.

faqs.a: Epley: 1RM = weight × (1 + reps/30). Brzycki: 1RM = weight × 36 / (37 − reps). Both are well-known estimates, most accurate for 1–10 reps.
They are estimates, not guarantees. Both formulas assume a fresh, maximal effort with good form; fatigue, technique and the specific lift all shift the real number.
The table shows each percentage of your estimated 1RM, which is exactly how most strength programs prescribe warm-up and working sets.

howto: Enter how many clean reps you completed (1–12).
Compare the Epley and Brzycki 1RM estimates.
Use the 55–100% table to plan warm-up and working sets.
title: One-Rep Max Calculator
